newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Draka to acquire French cable activities.
newsitem.headline: Draka to acquire French cable activities.

text.p: Dutch Draka Holding NV said on Wednesday it had agreed to buy French GIFI Groep cable activities.
Draka said it expected the acquisition to be completed this year. No financial details were given on the acquisition, but Draka said the deal would be funded from cash flow.

GIFI's cable activities, which employ 450 staff, generate turnover of 135 million guilders. Draka said the business was made up of 45 percent in energy cabling, 25 percent in data cabling and 30 percent in aerospace and electronic cabling.
Draka said the French market was the second biggest in Europe for cable activities and for this reason was of strategic importance for Draka.
Draka Holding had turnover of 1.2 billion guilders in 1995, with profits of 65.4 million guilders.
